Notes

The geometry here is deliberately integral: fixed widths, fixed heights, and no fractional boxes anywhere. Every inherited style is reset on both elements, so the button and the block draw the same box.

Text is identical on both sides. Nothing loads from the network except assets served by the fixture origin itself, so this page renders the same offline as it does in continuous integration.
